traditional: the Sun sextile Saturn: a soft contact. Vitality, authority, and recognition supports limitation, delay, and hard structure — cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas.
modern: Identity meets limit and discipline. The self is built slowly, under weight, and tested against duty and consequence. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Practical, conservative, orderly. Benefits come grudgingly and mostly as stability rather than ease. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize selfhood and limit into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what selfhood and limit have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Disciplined and reliable; the risk is self-limiting caution and joyless striving.
shadow: The ease lets egotism and needing to be the center and fear and rigidity go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.
